definitions.explanation: The substances a plant, animal or person takes in to grow and live. Especially common for plants and soil ({土|つち}の{養分|ようぶん}), and used figuratively for whatever feeds someone's growth.

examples.english: It draws nutrients through its roots.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{養分|ようぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、すべて⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{養分|ようぶん}になっている。
examples.english: Even the failures of my youth have all become nourishment for who I am now.
